notes.text: Soraka Initial Star Damage: 190/285 AP ⇒ 225/335 AP
Game Feel: Champion Drag and Drop snappiness has been improved
Late Game Performance: Upgraded our particle flusher tool to boost performance on round transitions and Carousel
Maladaptive: Using an Item Remover on a starred-up Adaptor no longer swaps them back to their one-star scaling
Players can no longer repeatedly fight a ghost army multiple rounds in a row
Alune’s ability can no longer target untargetable units
Certain Adaptor units no longer revert to a their alternate form’s Mana costs
Master of All Origins now has proper Icons
Augment Pillars no longer have white boxes appearing in the icon right after acquiring an Augment
Double Up: Upgraded Life Debt wisps now properly eliminates players. Maybe don’t buy it at 1 HP.
Double Up: Final Showdown Encounter now properly gives the two final duos 70 gold
Added a spinner graphic to pre-match loading screens for all platforms.
Fixed an exploit where temporary items would become permanent if traded with the friendship cannon.
Fixed an issue with a few ability/action instances such as Elise’s transformation, Maokai’s death, Sejuani’s weapon swipe, Sentinel’s Idle VFX, and Tristana’s AOE Explosion having memory leaks.
Fixed a temporary delay in joining queues on Mobile
Fixed memory leak of particles in Arena Prancie’s Retreat
MOBILE: Fixed an issue where the “Update Available” modal would in rare instances kick a player from Mobile on certain devices
Fixed an issue where Loot orbs would pop-in later than their trailing VFX when dropping from a minion in a PvE round
Temporarily Disabled Forge A Friend Augment as it wasn’t consistently providing a three-star unit.
MOBILE: Fixed an issue where some Mobile devices were running TFT in settings that surpassed their hardware recommendations resulting in poor performance
Fixed an issue where Health Bar subticks rendered too wide
Fixed an issue with Default Key functions
MOBILE: Fixed an issue where the “Update Available” modal was unable to be interacted with on certain Mobile devices
Fixed a bug where Teemo’s mushroom loot could land outside the board on certain Arenas after casting his ability during combat
Prestige Shyvana will now properly play her Dragon Form boom while in Dragon form
Change from Vulcan to OpenGL for specific GPUs to reduce graphics related crashes
Changing the default quality settings for some devices that were performing poorly
Fixed a memory leak with the Golden Egg asset
Fixed a memory leak that could happen when playing Rengar, which could lead to performance issues over time.
Fixed the End of Game screen sometimes showing the wrong final placement for the players who finished 1st and 2nd in Ranked games.
Fixed the "Soul Awakening" Augment's True Damage only working on Attack Damage instead of also applying to Ability Damage.
Fixed a bug where changing your loadout in TFT could accidentally unequip items from your League of Legends loadout.
Fixed a localization bug on mobile where the Performance Mode graphics setting showed English text instead of your selected language.
Fixed the "Bobabear" section of the Tacticians loadout screen showing untranslated (English-only) text.
Fixed some in-progress cosmetic category titles and item names showing in English regardless of your language setting.
Fixed a matchmaking issue that could cause you to face the same opponent two rounds in a row.
Fixed combat sometimes failing to end properly when Gnar knocked a Krug off the board.
Fixed Little Legend finisher sound effects continuing to play even after turning Global Volume/SFX down to 0.
Fixed the scoreboard constantly shifting position when purchasing Charms.
Fixed a bug preventing players from opening Settings
Fixed overlapping music tracks playing at the same time.
Improved Kennen's AOE visual effects so they scale better on lower graphics settings.
Improvements to Performance Mode for lower-spec devices to help maintain frame rate.
Fixed some load time related issues.
Fixed several minor memory leak sources.

Bugs: With a new set going live, there are always a few bugs to be found with the millions of games occurring in just the opening hours of a set. With a new engine, we expect that few to be more than usual, but as with PBE, we're actively working on fixing them, so as always please report any bugs you come across using community social spaces, support tickets, or the client.
Loading Times: Upon launch, loading into Enchanted Wilds will take longer than normal. We thank you for your patience during these load screens, and we are working on the back-end to reduce them.

Pings and Mini-map: You may notice that the mini-map is gone, and with it, pings are MIA. With the minimap gone, we still want to preserve the strategic (or humorous) communications from Pings, so we're taking Pings into the shop to rework them into a social tool that's not bound to the minimap. This will take some time and won't be ready on release, but we'll ping you when we've got a clearer understanding of their release timing.

Friend spectate on Live is something that we know is important for community super-contributors, community events, and just hanging out with your pals. It’s something we will not have on launch, but is on the docket to release long-term with the intention of a better spectator experience overall.
Patch Size: 18.1 is going to be big on the data size side of things, and the game side of things—it is a new set… Expect future patches to be smaller in size after our initial release.

Finishers: As we port our entire catalogue of Tacticians, Arenas, Booms, and Emotes over to Unreal, the trickiest aspect of our transition has been bringing over Finishers. As a temporary solution to speed up this process, we’re displaying Finishers as a video rather than in engine. Until Finishers are rebuilt in engine, they’ll be performed on River Sprites.

Cosmetics: Migrating all our cosmetics over from Hextech to Unreal is going to take some time. Each patch we plan on adding more and more cosmetics until we’ve achieved parity. For a detailed list of the Cosmetics available on release, please see the section at the end of these notes.

Wisps are split into 7 Categories (Champion, Combat, Misc, Shop, Gold/XP, Risky, Item). These categories have distinct coloring and icons to make rolling down and scouting as their icon will appear by a player's Tactician HP bar upon purchase.
Wisps can only be purchased during the planning phase. After the planning phase, the Wisp will be whisked away, revealing the unit that was hiding behind it.
Wisps appear in every other shop.
After stage 5, every other Wisp is guaranteed to be a Combat Wisp.
Carousel now has a chance to contain more champions and/or champions with a higher costs than normal.
Units will no longer retarget after returning from Crowd Control.
Missed loot from Stage 4-7, or later PVE rounds, can now overflow to the next PVE round.
Completed Item Anvil Start: All players start with a Completed Item Anvil.
Reroll Subscription: Gain rerolls at the start of each stage.
Item Forge: All players start with 2 Completed Item Anvils.
Band of Thieves II Delay: 6 Player Combats ⇒ 5 Player Combats
Backline Blueprint / Frontline Foundation: Tooltip updated to say 'class' instead of 'last-listed trait'.
Birthday Reunion Rework: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion. When you reach Level 6, random component. When you reach Level 9, gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion.
Bronze for Life I/II Damage Amp %: 2 ⇒ 2.5%
Challenger's Grace Renamed from Precision and Grace
Comeback Story Attack Speed Per Missing Player Health: 0.4% ⇒ 0.3%
Healing Orbs Heal is now instant. Now looks at the allies within 3 hexes of the target and heals the lowest % health ally (rather than just nearest). Defaults to nearest if no one is within 3 hexes
Forged in Strength Health Threshold: 30 ⇒ 35. Reward: 3 random Artifacts ⇒ 1 Artifact, 1 random completed item, 2 random components
Max Build Rework: Gain 10 free shop rerolls. When you reach level 9, gain 3 free shop rerolls and a Champion Duplicator.
Pandora's Bench Now is less likely to reroll 2-star copies of champions with few copies left in the pool.
Slightly Magical Roll 6 Cashout: Spatula ⇒ random Emblem
Shields have 40% of their value converted to max Health instead.
Aegis of Dusk: MR Damage Percent: 15% ⇒ 18%
Talisman of Ascension: NEW When Ascended gain 12 Mana Regen
Titanic Hydra: % basic Attack Damage as Bonus Damage: 6% ⇒ 2%
Twisted Fate: On Round 1-2 only, minimum roll is set to 5.
